design_description: A refined heritage-inspired design that transforms the jersey into an elegant illustrated landscape celebrating the character of Sainte-Agnès. The clean white base is accented with delicate lavender line-art depicting rolling hills, village architecture, and soft cloud formations, creating the feel of a classic engraved illustration. The artwork is concentrated around the lower body and fades naturally upward, preserving a clean chest area for the sponsor and club identity. Lavender and deep blue trim on the collar and sleeve cuffs complements the illustration, reinforcing the calm, sophisticated color palette. Overall, the jersey feels timeless, artistic, and deeply rooted in local heritage, blending football performance with the charm of a traditional landscape engraving.
